integrity: All finite calculations are reproducible from the embedded standalone standard-library program; the infinite proof is written out separately. No independent audit or publication-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the integral relabeling-module, not an equivariant homotopy type, and applies only to two-subset Kneser graphs for n>=4. The classification of full graph automorphisms when n=4 is not asserted; the broader 2004 equivariant question for matching size k>2 is not addressed; nonindexed published solutions remain a priority risk. Finite verification is supportive, not a proof of the uniform claim.
title: Integral symmetric-group homology of two-subset Kneser independence complexes
